title: SEM Sample Preparation Protocol
author: Tim D'angelo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w9ufh6w

steps.title: Fix Samples
steps.instruction: Submerge the sample in an appropriate amount of 4% PFA in PBS using sterile forceps in a 1.5 ml eppitube.

substeps.instruction: Incubate in a 4°C refrigerator for 1 - 3 hours.
Dispose of PFA waste in the G2 waste container in the Biological Safety Cabinet.

steps.title: Prepare Ethanol Dilution Series
steps.instruction: Create a dilution series of ethanol in milliq water at concentrations of 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, 90%, and 100% by diluting 100% ethanol in milliq water.

substeps.instruction: Filter all dilutions using a syringe and 0.2uM filter.

steps.title: Dehydrate Samples
steps.instruction: Perform ethanol dehydration by submerging samples in the prepared ethanol dilutions.

substeps.instruction: Fill eppitubes or petri dishes with enough of each ethanol solution to submerge the samples.
Incubate samples in each dilution for 10 minutes, transferring between dilutions with sterile forceps.
Allow ethanol waste to evaporate in the hood or dump down the sink while running the faucet.

steps.title: HMDS Treatment
steps.instruction: Incubate samples in 100% HMDS for 10 minutes using eppitubes or petri dishes.

substeps.instruction: Dispose of HMDS waste in the Q22 waste container in the flammable’s cabinet under the Fume hood in A211.

steps.title: Air-Dry Samples
steps.instruction: Remove samples and place them in a sterile petri dish to air-dry in the fume hood for 48 hours.

steps.title: Prepare Aluminum Stub
steps.instruction: Prepare the mounting stub for the sample.

substeps.instruction: Label the underside of the aluminum stub with the sample number using a sharpie marker.
Peel the carbon disc (two-sided tape) away from the backing and secure it to the aluminum stub.

steps.title: Mount Sample
steps.instruction: Attach the sample to the prepared stub.

substeps.instruction: Using sterilized forceps, pick up the sample (e.g., rock chip) and gently press it onto the two-sided carbon tape.
If mounting filtered samples, affix the 0.2 μM filter to the two-sided tape instead.

steps.title: Apply Conductive Tape
steps.instruction: Secure the sample with conductive tape to ensure electrical contact.

substeps.instruction: Cut a small strip of conductive tape approximately 10-12mm long and cut it in half lengthwise with sharp scissors.
Peel off the sticky backing and attach the strips to two opposite edges of the two-sided tape.
Press the tape firmly down with forceps to ensure good contact.

steps.title: Store Mounted Samples
steps.instruction: Store the mounted samples and any filter remains in the stub holder.

substeps.instruction: Preferably store in a dessicator or a closed container with a dessicant pack.
